title: One-step synthesis of 2-cyclopentylcyclopentanone from cyclopentanone catalyzed by NiO-Co3O4/TiO2: reaction pathway
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4SE01411A, Paper
Rui Zhang, Danhui Li, Peng Zhao, Lili Zhao, Hualiang An
Reaction pathway for one-step synthesis of 2-cyclopentylcyclopentanone from cyclopentanone over NiO-Co3O4/TiO2 is first proposed. The sequence for appearance of active sites is first acid–base active sites, followed by hydrogenation active site.
